integrity: The transfer bijection, symbolic characteristic polynomial, exact rational root intervals, finite independent brute-force comparisons and signed trace values are supplied with an executable verifier. Independent validation is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives signed face sums and an all-parameter rational homology lower bound, but not individual Betti numbers, integral torsion, or homotopy types. Unindexed equivalent work cannot be excluded.
title: Exponential rational homology in circular-ladder two-independence complexes
